title: Credit Card Four-Key USB Macro Pad

via.rationale: Commodity two-layer through-via geometry used board-wide; 0.15 mm annular ring meets the selected ordinary JLCPCB profile without a via-in-pad process.

GND.rationale: Dual-layer GND fills for the controller, connector, microphone, analog block, and hot-swap sockets. Automatic rescue vias must bond any bottom fill fragments through the opposing top fill. The 0.15 mm clearance supports J1 pin 2 without a via in its solder land.

VBUS.rationale: USB 5 V from the XIAO module and LCD backlight supply.

V3V3.rationale: XIAO-regulated 3.3 V logic and microphone rail. The load is below 250 mA; use 0.30 mm distribution with only a qualified 0.25 mm, 2 mm maximum fine-pitch escape at J1 pin 7.

escape.rationale: Explicit fine-pitch escape at J1 pin 7; widen to 0.30 mm immediately outside the connector land.

LCD_MOSI.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI data trace; no controlled-impedance requirement. Use a qualified 0.20 mm route at J1 pin 5 to preserve the 0.15 mm manufacturing clearance between adjacent 0.5 mm-pitch escapes.

escape.rationale: Explicit 0.20 mm fine-pitch escape at J1 pin 5; widen to 0.25 mm outside the connector fanout where the router permits.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI clock; keep away from the microphone block and route over continuous ground.

escape.rationale: Explicit fine-pitch escape at J1 pin 6.

LCD_CS_N.rationale: LCD chip select; a 0.20 mm route is permitted only for the fine-pitch J1 escape.

escape.rationale: Explicit 0.20 mm fine-pitch escape at outer J1 pin 8; widen to 0.30 mm outside the connector fanout where the router permits.
Explicit fine-pitch escape at J1 pin 4.

LCD_RESET_N.rationale: Hardware RC reset node; explicit 0.15 mm clearance is required only at J1 pin 3 beside the qualified GND escape via.

escape.rationale: Explicit fine-pitch escape at J1 pin 3.

LCD_LEDA.rationale: Resistor-limited LCD backlight current is below 120 mA; 0.30 mm external 1 oz copper is adequate for this short run and fits J1 pin 1 without an automatic width override.

MIC_RAW.rationale: ZTS6216 analog output before AC coupling.

MIC_AC.rationale: AC-coupled microphone signal biased at VBIAS.

VBIAS.rationale: Filtered 1.65 V virtual ground for the preamplifier.

MIC_FB.rationale: TLV9061 feedback node; minimize loop area.

MIC_AMP.rationale: Amplified microphone signal before anti-alias resistor.

MIC_ADC.rationale: Filtered ADC input to XIAO D8.

keepouts.name: U1_ANTENNA_COPPER_KEEPOUT
keepouts.rationale: Keep carrier copper clear beneath the XIAO ESP32S3 antenna end.
